comments: "Arista 7010TX-48 - a fixed 1RU data-centre access switch with 48 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 ports\
  \ and four 1/10/25 Gigabit Ethernet SFP ports, running EOS. The front carries the 48 jacks in two stacked\
  \ rows (the odd number on top) in four blocks of six columns, the four SFP cages in a two-by-two block,\
  \ and at the right an RJ-45 management port over a USB port over an RJ-45 serial console, with three\
  \ status lamps (system, fan tray, power supplies). The rear carries two internal power supplies (PS1\
  \ and PS2, built in and not field-replaceable), the one hot-swappable reversible fan module, a hex vent\
  \ field and a two-hole grounding pair. The same panel is ordered with AC supplies (C14 inlets) or DC\
  \ supplies (a two-pole terminal block each, a different rear), front-to-back (-F) or back-to-front (-R)\
  \ air, and as the 7010TX-48C part numbers, which differ from the 7010TX-48 in memory and minimum EOS\
  \ release only.\n\nConfiguration `dc-f`: The DC build, front-to-back air: two internal -48 V DC supplies\
  \ on terminal blocks (a different rear), the fan module as in the AC front-to-back build. Ordered as\
  \ DCS-7010TX-48-DC-F; the 7010TX-48C-DC of the same build is dc-c-f.\n\nDatasheet: 7010X Series Data\
  \ Center Switches Data Sheet (Arista Networks, 03-0052-14, Aug 20th 2025)\n  https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/Datasheets/7010TX-Datasheet.pdf\n\
